species.name: Poison Dart Frog
mustRead: tiny smooth body in vivid warning colours
bold contrasting blotches or stripes
rounded blunt snout with jet-black eyes
species.note: very small and smooth-skinned - no warts, no webbing, no toe discs of any size

species.name: Bullfrog
mustRead: large circular eardrum disc behind the eye
very wide flat mouth line
powerful folded hind legs with webbed feet
species.note: smooth-skinned with no dorsal ridges; the tympanum is bigger than the eye in males

species.name: Glass Frog
mustRead: translucent belly showing heart and gut
lime-green translucent upperside
forward-facing pale gold eyes
species.note: the eyes point forward, not sideways, and the underside must read as see-through

species.name: Pika
mustRead: round egg-shaped body with no visible tail
large round pale-rimmed ears
very short legs holding the belly close to the rock
species.note: a lagomorph, but the ears are short and round - not long like a rabbit's - and there is no visible tail

species.name: Rabbit
mustRead: long upright ears
short round powder-puff tail
heavy crouched hind legs

species.name: Hare
mustRead: very long black-tipped ears
long rangy hind legs
lean angular body
species.note: Leggier and rangier than a rabbit, with proportionally much longer ears.

species.name: Frog
mustRead: bulging eyes set on top of the head
folded haunches with long hind legs
wide flat mouth line and no tail

species.name: Snowshoe Hare
mustRead: oversized furry hind feet
black-tipped ears shorter than a jackrabbit's
white winter coat

species.name: Wood Frog
mustRead: black robber's mask through the eye
pale dorsolateral ridges down the back
long folded jumping legs

species.name: Jackrabbit
mustRead: enormous ears longer than the head
very long powerful hind legs
large eye set high and far back on the skull

species.name: Jerboa
mustRead: stilt-like hind legs several times the front legs
tail far longer than the body with a black-and-white tuft
huge round eyes and large ears
species.note: Stands and moves on the hind legs only; the tiny forelimbs are held tucked at the chest.

species.name: Mara
mustRead: long slim deer-like legs on a rodent body
tall rabbit-like ears
almost no tail
species.note: Reads as a hare crossed with a small antelope; do not draw it as a squat guinea-pig shape.

species.name: Toad
mustRead: squat warty wide-bodied hunch
bulging eyes with a swollen gland behind each
short hind legs folded, no visible neck or tail
species.note: Squatter and shorter-legged than a frog, with dry bumpy skin and a broader flatter head.

species.name: Arctic Hare
mustRead: thick white coat with black ear tips
short ears for a hare
very large hind feet

species.name: Cave Frog
mustRead: squat crouched body with folded hind legs
wide flat head as broad as the body
pale translucent depigmented skin
species.note: Generic - interpreted as a representative pale cave-dwelling frog; eyes reduced but still present and bulging.

species.name: Kangaroo
mustRead: massive muscular hind legs and long feet
thick tapering tail used as a third leg
tiny forearms held against the chest

species.name: Wallaby
mustRead: crouched hopping stance with deep folded hind legs
long flat hind feet
thick tail trailing along the ground
species.note: Shorter-faced, smaller and more compact than a kangaroo; the body is more hunched and rabbit-like.
